sub_service: Application for a new water/drainage connection via PMC's Enterprise GIS (EGIS) Portal
problem_type: Need to apply for a new water supply connection to a property in Pune
department: Pune Municipal Corporation -- Water Supply Department (via the Enterprise GIS / EGIS Portal)
authority: Junior Engineer (JE) assessment, Deputy Engineer (DE) approval
description: This is a distinct service from reporting a problem with an EXISTING water/drainage connection (see MH_PMC_GENERAL_GRIEVANCE_CHANNEL_WATER_DRAINAGE) -- this one is for applying for a brand new connection. Confirmed via a direct fetch and full read of PMC's own official Enterprise GIS Portal help document ('Steps to Apply for Water Connection', gis.pmc.gov.in), which lays out the real citizen-facing workflow end to end: apply through the EGIS Portal (registration required), identify and get sign-off from a PMC-authorized plumber, attach the mandatory documents, and the application then moves through Junior Engineer assessment, Deputy Engineer approval, a system-generated Demand Note, payment, and finally connection completion.
procedure: 1) Register for an account on PMC's EGIS Portal (gis.pmc.gov.in) if you don't already have one. 2) Go to City Map > Online Services > Water/Drainage Connection and open the application form. 3) Identify a PMC-authorized plumber near your property from the list on the form -- the plumber visits to confirm feasibility and fills out a Licensed Plumber Consent Letter. 4) Fill in all mandatory fields and attach the mandatory documents, then submit. 5) A Junior Engineer (JE) conducts an internal assessment and records the amount payable; status shows 'Junior Engineer Approved'. 6) A Deputy Engineer (DE) verifies and approves; status shows 'Deputy Engineer Approved'. 7) A Demand Note is generated automatically. 8) Pay the amount shown -- either online (redirects to Bill Desk) or offline (pay at your nearest CFC/payment centre and upload the receipt/challan). 9) Track progress any time via the portal's 'Track Status' utility; status shows 'Connection Completed' once the physical connection work is done.
required_information: A registered account on PMC's EGIS Portal (gis.pmc.gov.in)
Property details for the connection location
required_documents: Licensed Plumber Consent Letter (from a PMC-authorized plumber)
Owner's Consent Letter (only if the applicant is not the property owner)

faq.question: What documents do I need for a new water connection in Pune?
faq.answer: Site Plan, Completion Certificate, Commencement Certificate, Occupancy Certificate, and a Licensed Plumber Consent Letter from a PMC-authorized plumber -- plus an Owner's Consent Letter if you're not the property owner yourself.

faq.question: How much does a new water connection cost in Pune?
faq.answer: The source document doesn't publish a fixed fee -- the amount is calculated per application by a Junior Engineer and shown to you as a 'Demand Note' after you submit your application, payable online or at a nearby CFC/payment centre.

faq.question: Do I need to arrange a plumber myself?
faq.answer: Yes -- you must pick one from PMC's own list of authorized plumbers on the application form. They visit your property to confirm feasibility and sign a consent letter you upload with your application.

citizen_guidance: Apply only through PMC's official EGIS portal (gis.pmc.gov.in) -- Online Services > Water/Drainage Connection. You'll need to register for a portal account first if you don't have one.
source_title: Steps to Apply for Water Connection -- Pune Municipal Corporation Enterprise GIS (EGIS) Portal
